# Government Benefits Portal Accessibility Audit Plan

> **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol. Review with a11y-critic after implementation.  
> **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA  
> **Users who need accessibility:** Screen reader users, keyboard-only users, low vision users, mobile users, voice input users  
> **Assistive technologies:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, iOS VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard-only, Dragon NaturallySpeaking  

**Feature:** Accessibility audit of 20-page government benefits portal with 8 shared components and 3 third-party integrations  
**Risk Level:** High  
**Component/Page Type:** Multi-page application with public and authenticated flows  

---

## Scope & Context

This audit plan follows the **WCAG Evaluation Methodology (WCAG-EM) 2.0** (W3C Group Note 2026) for digital product conformance evaluation. The portal serves citizens applying for public assistance programs and must comply with WCAG 2.2 AA. The audit will produce a VPAT 2.4 Rev 508-compliant report in 3 months with a 2-person QA team.

---

## Page Sampling Strategy

### Risk-Based Prioritization (WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 4.2.1)
1. **CRITICAL (High Risk):** Authenticated application flows (6 steps)  
   - Multi-step form, document upload, session timeout modal  
   - Test all 6 steps for every user journey  
2. **MAJOR (Medium Risk):** Shared components used across all pages  
   - Global navigation (mega-menu), search with live results, in-page alerts/notifications  
   - Test once, apply fixes across all 20 pages  
3. **MINOR (Low Risk):** Public-facing content pages  
   - Home, About, FAQ, News, Contact (test 1 representative page per type)  
4. **ADVISORY (Optional):** Program Detail pages (test 3 variants)  

**Sampling Rationale:**  
- **CRITICAL flows** must be 100% tested due to user journey blocking potential.  
- **Shared components** are fixed once, reducing redundant testing.  
- **Public pages** are tested at 25% sampling (5/20 pages) due to low risk.  

---

## Tool Selection & Testing Matrix

| Tool/Method | Purpose | Pages/Components | WCAG-EM Alignment |
|-------------|---------|------------------|-------------------|
| **axe DevTools Enterprise** | Automated rule-based checks | All pages/components | WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 3.2.1 |
| **WAVE (WebAIM)** | Visual overlay for manual review | Public pages, shared components | WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 3.2.2 |
| **Playwright (Keyboard Testing)** | Real keyboard interaction validation | Authenticated flows, modals, forms | WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 3.2.3 |
| **NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver** | Screen reader compatibility | High-risk pages (auth flows, modals) | WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 3.2.4 |
| **Lighthouse (Accessibility)** | Baseline performance + accessibility | All pages | WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 3.2.5 |
| **Manual Testing** | Dynamic interactions (e.g., date picker, file upload) | Shared components | WCAG-EM 2.0 Section 3.2.6 |

---

## Automated Testing Setup (axe DevTools Enterprise)

### Configuration
- **Rule Sets:**  
  - `wcag22aa` (WCAG 2.2 AA compliance)  
  - `best-practices` (ARIA, focus management, semantic structure)  
- **Exclusions:**  
  - `color-contrast` (tested manually with visual regression)  
  - `aria-required-attr` (third-party components like reCAPTCHA)  

### Execution Plan
1. Run axe on all 20 pages in default state  
2. Run axe on 5 high-risk pages in error states (e.g., form validation)  
3. Export results to JSON for VPAT mapping  

---

## Keyboard Interaction Testing

### Focus Management Verification
- **Tab Order:** Validate logical flow on all pages (WCAG 2.4.3)  
- **Focus Traps:** Test modals, session timeout warning (WCAG 2.1.2)  
- **Composite Widgets:** Test mega-menu (arrow key navigation), date picker (Tab/Arrow)  

### Test Cases
- **Mega-menu:**  
  - Tab to menu → Arrow keys open/close → Tab through items  
- **Multi-step Form:**  
  - Tab through all fields → Enter submits step → Escape closes modal  
- **Document Upload:**  
  - Tab to upload button → Enter opens dialog → Tab through options  

---

## Screen Reader Testing Matrix

| Screen Reader | Pages Tested | Key Checks |
|---------------|--------------|-----------|
| **NVDA (Win10)** | Authenticated flows, modals | Landmarks, form labels, live regions |
| **JAWS (Win10)** | Multi-step form, alerts | Reading order, error announcements |
| **VoiceOver (macOS)** | Global navigation, search | Skip links, roving tabindex |
| **iOS VoiceOver** | Mobile-friendly pages | Responsive design, touch gestures |
| **TalkBack (Android)** | Mobile pages | Contextual navigation, gesture alternatives |

---

## Visual Regression Testing

### Focus & Contrast Checks
- **Focus Indicators:** Test at 200% zoom (WCAG 1.4.10)  
- **Color Contrast:** Manual verification of text (4.5:1) and UI components (3:1)  
- **Responsive Text:** Test font scaling at 200% (WCAG 1.4.4)  

### Tools
- **Playwright Visual Regression:** Capture screenshots at 100%, 200%  
- **Color Contrast Checker (WebAIM):** Validate critical UI elements  

---

## ARIA State Testing

### Key Components
- **Mega-menu:** `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup`  
- **Session Timeout Modal:** `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`  
- **Form Validation:** `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`  

### Test Cases
- **Mega-menu:**  
  - Open menu → `aria-expanded="true"` → Screen reader announces "Expanded"  
- **Form Errors:**  
  - Submit invalid form → Error message announced via `aria-live="assertive"`  

---

## Test Prioritization Framework

| Level | Definition | Examples |
|-------|------------|----------|
| **CRITICAL** | Blocks user journey completion | Form submission failure, missing labels, broken focus trap |
| **MAJOR** | Significant friction with workaround | Missing skip link, poor error messages |
| **MINOR** | Inconvenience but not blocking | Missing alt text on decorative images |
| **ADVISORY** | Best practice but not required | Missing `aria-label` on decorative icons |

---

## Third-Party Component Handling

### reCAPTCHA v2
- **VPAT Documentation:**  
  - **Support Level:** Partial (WCAG 2.2 AA)  
  - **Exception:** Cannot remediate due to third-party control  
  - **Workaround:** Provide visual alternative for voice input users  

### YouTube Embeds
- **VPAT Documentation:**  
  - **Support Level:** Partial  
  - **Exception:** Captions must be manually added by content team  
  - **Workaround:** Provide transcript link for videos  

### Analytics Script
- **VPAT Documentation:**  
  - **Support Level:** Full (no accessibility impact)  
  - **Verification:** Script does not inject content or alter DOM  

---

## VPAT Reporting Structure

### Conformance Claims
- **Support Level Legend:**  
  - **A:** Full support  
  - **B:** Partial support with workaround  
  - **C:** Not supported (third-party exceptions)  

### Mapping to WCAG 2.2 AA
- **Common Failures in Government Sites:**  
  - 1.4.3 (Low contrast in alerts)  
  - 2.4.4 (Poor link text)  
  - 3.3.2 (Missing form instructions)  
  - 4.1.2 (Incorrect ARIA attributes)  

### VPAT Sections
1. **Product Description**  
2. **Conformance Claim** (A/B/C per criterion)  
3. **Evaluation Methodology** (WCAG-EM 2.0)  
4. **Remarks and Explanations** (third-party exceptions, workarounds)  

---

## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints

| Checkpoint | After Task | Focus Areas |
|------------|------------|-------------|
| 🔍 1 | Automated testing | axe rule exclusions, false positives |
| 🔍 2 | Keyboard testing | Focus traps, composite widget navigation |
| 🔍 3 | Screen reader testing | Landmark structure, live region announcements |
| 🔍 4 | VPAT draft | Third-party exceptions, conformance claims |
| 🔍 5 | Final audit | Test coverage completeness, risk prioritization |

---

## Implementation Tasks

### Task 1: Automated Testing Setup
- **Files:** `audit/config/axe-rules.js`  
- **ARIA Attributes:** None (automated tooling)  
- **Tests:**  
  - Validate axe configuration excludes third-party components  
  - Run baseline scan on all 20 pages  

### Task 2: Keyboard Testing (Auth Flows)
- **Files:** `audit/test/auth-flows.spec.js`  
- **Tests:**  
  - Tab through multi-step form  
  - Escape closes session timeout modal  

### Task 3: Screen Reader Testing (Mega-menu)
- **Files:** `audit/test/screen-reader.spec.js`  
- **Tests:**  
  - NVDA announces menu items  
  - VoiceOver skips to main content  

---

## Failure Modes to Avoid

- **Over-testing low-risk pages:** Wasting time on decorative content  
- **Ignoring third-party exceptions:** VPAT will be legally non-compliant  
- **Missing shared component fixes:** Redundant testing across 20 pages  
- **Automated-only testing:** Missing keyboard/SR/dynamic interaction issues  

---

## References

- [WCAG Evaluation Methodology 2.0](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em/)  
- [ITTF VPAT 2.4 Rev 508 Template](https://www.ittf.org/vpat)  
- [axe DevTools Enterprise Rules](https://deque.com/axe/enterprise/)  
- [WCAG 2.2 AA Success Criteria](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/quickref/)  

---

**Final Note:** This plan leverages shared components to reduce redundant testing, prioritizes high-risk flows, and aligns with WCAG-EM for VPAT compliance. The a11y-critic checkpoints ensure the plan is followed rigorously.
